# Is My Job AI-Proof?

> A free, task-level AI job resilience self-assessment. Scores are planning indicators, not job-loss probabilities.

- [Assessment](https://ismyjobaiproof.com/)
- [AI Job Exposure Rankings](https://ismyjobaiproof.com/rankings/): Browse and compare all 550 distinct occupation baselines.
- [Methodology](https://ismyjobaiproof.com/methodology/): Inputs, formulas, weights and limitations for Model 1.0.
- [About](https://ismyjobaiproof.com/about/)
- [Editorial policy](https://ismyjobaiproof.com/editorial-policy/)
- [Privacy](https://ismyjobaiproof.com/privacy/)

## Interpretation

AI exposure measures how much work current generative AI can reach. Automation pressure also considers workflow and adoption. Human advantage reflects trust, accountability, physical context and judgment. Augmentation upside estimates where AI can improve work while a person remains responsible.

Data snapshot: 2026-07-16
Model version: 1.0
Privacy: Questionnaire answers remain in browser memory and are not uploaded.
